# Atlas license references

Original legal texts retrieved from Creative Commons on 2026-09-21:

- [CC-BY-4.0.txt](CC-BY-4.0.txt):
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/legalcode.txt
- [CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt](CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt):
  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/legalcode.txt

The WHS atlas project page states CC BY 4.0, while its citation page links to
CC BY-SA 4.0 despite also saying CC BY. These files are references, not a new
license grant for the atlas or an assertion that either license can be chosen.
See [atlas attribution and the unresolved terms](../../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md#atlas-data-and-readme-images).
